name: Hidden Door Sensor
description: The Hidden Door Sensor, with an adjustable heartbeat interval and low battery level.

enumerations.name: doorState
enumerations.description: The door's state, as a status request reports it.

operatingFlags.name: cleanupReport
operatingFlags.description: The sensor sends a success report after each group broadcast.

operatingFlags.name: twoGroups
operatingFlags.description: The sensor sends on to group 1 when opened and on to group 2 when closed.

operatingFlags.name: repeatOpen
operatingFlags.description: The sensor repeats its open message every 5 minutes for 50 minutes.

operatingFlags.name: repeatClosed
operatingFlags.description: The sensor repeats its closed message every 5 minutes for 50 minutes.

operatingFlags.name: linkToAllGroups
operatingFlags.description: One link to group 0xFF puts a device in every group: open, closed, low battery and heartbeat.

operatingFlags.name: programmingLock
operatingFlags.description: Linking from the sensor's SET button is locked out.

readings.name: databaseDelta
readings.description: A count that goes up whenever the link database changes. It clears when the device loses power.

flagCommands.name: stayAwakeOn
flagCommands.description: Keeps the sensor awake, with 0xFF as its awake interval.

values.name: operatingFlags
values.description: The operating flags, as Get Operating Flags with cmd2 0x00 reads them.

values.name: batteryLevel
values.description: The battery level: about 0x61 at 1.75 V, 0x54 at 1.6 V, 0x51 at 1.5 V and 0x40 at 1.25 V.

verification.note: The Hidden Door Sensor's developer guide gives 0x00 and 0xFF, but its tables disagree on which one means open.

values.name: heartbeatInterval
values.description: The heartbeat interval in 5-minute steps, from 0x01 (5 minutes) to 0xFF. 0x00 is 24 hours.

values.name: lowBatteryLevel
values.description: The battery level below which the sensor sends low battery. It's 0x40, about 1.25 V, by default.

standardCommands.name: readDoorState
standardCommands.description: Reads whether the door is open.

reply.name: batteryLevel
reply.description: The battery level: about 0x61 at 1.75 V, 0x54 at 1.6 V, 0x51 at 1.5 V and 0x40 at 1.25 V.

extendedCommands.name: readSettings
extendedCommands.description: Reads the operating flags, battery level, door state, heartbeat interval and low battery level.

values.name: batteryLevel
values.description: The battery level: about 0x61 at 1.75 V, 0x54 at 1.6 V, 0x51 at 1.5 V and 0x40 at 1.25 V.

verification.note: The Hidden Door Sensor's developer guide gives 0x00 and 0xFF, but its tables disagree on which one means open.

values.name: lowBatteryLevel
values.description: The battery level below which the sensor sends low battery.

parameters.name: heartbeatInterval
parameters.description: The heartbeat interval, in 5-minute steps. 0 means 24 hours.

notes: The sensor sleeps to save its battery, and hears commands only while awake.
Direct commands from a device that isn't in the sensor's link database get a NAK with 0xFF in cmd2.
The acknowledgment of readDoorState also carries the link database's delta, in cmd1.
The guide's status request reads 0xFF as open and 0x00 as closed, but its extended Get table reads them the other way. doorState follows the status request.
The guide describes 0x0A, repeat open, as repeating a closed message. This reads it as repeating the open message, as its name says.
